description: This PHP class 'ConsoleWatcherListener' handles various project lifecycle events such as publishing, ending, activation, and monitoring. It manages notifications, feed entries, and reminders related to project statuses within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: ConsoleWatcherListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling project-related events such as publish, ending, activation, and monitoring, with methods for sending notifications and logging feeds.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, warning if duplicate, otherwise notices it as populated.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a notification message to project owner or consultants, ensuring no duplicate events.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish event, logs feed, and notifies admin and public feeds.

methods.name: onProjectEnding
methods.description: Handles project ending event, logs ending feed, and notifies.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles active project event, sends advice and reminders based on campaign progress.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Handles project monitoring event, sends reminders about project fulfillment and social rewards.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to, with priorities.
